svg.aria-label: Storing passwords: never in plain text and never with a fast hash. Add a unique random salt per user and run a slow, memory-hard hash such as Argon2id or bcrypt; store only the salt and the hash. To log in, recompute and compare.

svg.text: billions of guesses/s on a GPU
Login: look up the salt, hash the typed password the same way, compare in constant time.
